cols.text: Each row shows layout B1 in one visual style: writing an equation, the Library tab after Copy, and the pop-out window. Layout and words are the same in every row.

captextbook.text:
S1 – Textbook
Warm paper, serif labels and one oxblood accent. The equation sits between two printed rules.

capblackboard.text:
S2 – Blackboard
Dark slate with chalk white and one chalk yellow. Dark is the home theme here.

capgraph.text:
S3 – Graph paper
Squared paper under the equation, blue ink, and keys ruled as one grid.

capcalc.text:
S4 – Calculator
A scientific calculator: a pale display, raised keys and one orange main key.

capsign.text:
S5 – Wayfinding
Public signage: thick black lines, a blue header and yellow for what is selected or done.

capradical.text:
S6 – Radical
The icon made into the panel. The equation sits under a blue radical sign on navy.
